content.value: . A large condenser has several column of tube with 33 tubes in each column. The outer diameter of the tube is 1.5 cm. The condenser operates at a pressure of 12.35 kPa and the outer surfaces of the tubes are maintained at $2 0 ^ { \circ } C$ . Determine (i) the average heat transfer coefficient, (ii) the rate of condensation of steam per unit length of a column.
